content:
sam: Morning — seeing a spike in mTLS handshake failures (TLS alert 40) between proxy-us-east -> proxy-eu-west starting ~2026-03-20 23:40 UTC after the RBAC change deploy. Failures correlate with keystore GET latency and KMS 429s. Anyone else?
anya: on it, can you paste a short log snippet?
sam: sure — hitting this pattern repeatedly: 
```
2026-03-20T23:41:12Z proxy-us-east handshake failed: tls: handshake failure (alert 40)
keystore: GET /v1/certs/service-proxy?region=eu-west latency=312ms status=200 req_id=abc123
kms: Decrypt call client=keystore region=eu-west status=429 rate_limit_exceeded retry_after=1s req_id=def456
```
mike: deploy-bot shows the RBAC policy change rolled at 2026-03-20T23:39:18Z (deploy id: deploy-7789). Might be coincident but worth checking.
deploy-bot: deploy completed by mike at 2026-03-20T23:39:18Z — commit 5c1b2a3
tara: quick question — did the RBAC change affect the keystore role that signs/reads cert metadata?
sam: yes — role scope for keystore-read was tightened to exclude the proxy service account in eu-west; proxies should have used cached certs but we have short TTL for live cert rotation (60s) so we end up fetching on many connections. Under load KMS hit its decrypt QPS limit.
anya: that explains 429s. Two immediate mitigations: increase cert cache TTL to 30m and enable exponential backoff/retry for keystore calls. Can proxy config be hot-updated?
mike: we can push a safe hotfix to the proxy fleet that bumps cache TTL env var and adds jitter to keystore retries, yes. rolling canary then all-region.
cloudops-bot: opened issue <https://tickets.internal/INC-3218|INC-3218> "KMS rate-limit after RBAC tighten causing mTLS handshake failures" and tagged @cloudops @eng-security.
tara: I will produce an audit slice for the RBAC change (who, what, when) and attach to the ticket. Need to confirm whether the RBAC delta accidentally removed the keystore read scope.
sam: action plan: 
- sam: push proxy hotfix (cache TTL -> 30m, retry backoff + jitter) — target canary in 15m
- anya: collect keystore+KMS metrics and bucket by service account + region, attach to INC-3218
- tara: audit RBAC diff and propose minimal rollback patch if needed
- mike: coordinate canary and smoke tests; prepare rollback playbook
All: please ack here when you start.
anya: starting metrics pull now.
mike: prepping canary job, will schedule at +15m.
sam: pushing small proxy patch to feature/proxy-cache-ttl; quick diff: 
```yaml
env:
  CERT_CACHE_TTL: 1800  # 30m in seconds
  KEYSTORE_RETRY_BASE_MS: 50
  KEYSTORE_RETRY_MAX_MS: 2000
  KEYSTORE_RETRY_JITTER: true
```
mike: noted. smoke test plan: TLS handshake succeed >99% for 1k concurrent connections to proxy-eu-west from probe.
tara: audit snippet: RBAC change tightened "keystore.read" to role "svc-proxy" but scope expression excluded "svc-proxy-eu-west" namespace inadvertently. attaching diff.
sam: good find. if rollback is needed it's a config tweak; but try hotfix first to buy time.
cloudops-bot: pinged KMS team about temporary quota bump; request id Q-9981.
anya: metrics show KMS decryptQPS spiked to 2.3k in eu-west at 23:41 and error rate to 18% for a 3m window. caching at 30m should cut traffic ~95% for these short-lived certs.
mike: canary started, 10% traffic to patched proxies. early smoke: handshake failures dropped from 12% -> 0.8% on canary nodes.
sam: rolling to 50% now.
tara: I've attached the RBAC diff and will open a follow-up PR to re-add the specific namespace exception for svc-proxy-eu-west with a note for postmortem.
anya: keeping the ticket updated with graphs. will also add a regression test for cert TTL interplay with RBAC changes.
mike: once patch fully rolled, let's schedule a short postmortem doc with timeline and lessons (cache heuristics + RBAC gating).
sam: ack — will follow up in INC-3218 with RCA and action items. thanks all :thumbsup:
anya: thanks — closing emergency loop, will continue metric watches for next 2 hours.
cloudops-bot: KMS team replied: monitoring quota bump in progress, expected within 10m.
mike: 100% rollout complete, handshake failures back to baseline.
sam: last check — leaving incident open for RCA until postmortem published.
tara: ack.
